title: Children with Pony and Calf on Farm, 1920s Sepia Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: Mary Geo Jean + myself- the over sized one - Geo's pony & calf SELBRO 65
description: A charming 1920s rural snapshot depicting four children—Mary, Geo, Jean, and the author—posing outdoors on a farm alongside a small pony and a calf. A large farm silo stands tall in the background, anchoring the scene in American agrarian history during the interwar era.
